# Stackby

Stackby combines spreadsheets, databases, and workflow automation so teams can organize data, collaborate, and manage business processes.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/stackby/.

## Actions

- **Create Rows**: Create 1 to 10 rows in a Stackby table in one request.
- **Delete Rows**: Delete 1 to 10 identified rows from a Stackby table.
- **List Columns** (read-only): List columns and their types for a Stackby table so row field names can be chosen correctly.
- **List Rows** (read-only): List one page of rows from a Stackby table, or retrieve specific rows by ID, with optional filtering, view selection, and single-field…
- **List Stacks** (read-only): List accessible Stackby stacks in a known workspace and return IDs needed for table discovery.
- **List Tables** (read-only): List tables in a Stackby stack and return their IDs and names.
- **List Views** (read-only): Return view IDs and names for a Stackby table for use in view-scoped row queries.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): List accessible Stackby workspaces and return the workspace IDs needed to discover stacks.
- **Update Rows**: Partially update 1 to 10 existing Stackby rows in one request.
